text: STRATEGY BUYS BACK $176.3 MILLION IN STRC, DOUBLES PREFERRED STOCK REPURCHASE PROGRAM TO $2 BILLION Strategy says it repurchased 1.81 million STRC shares between August 31 and September 7, while making no Bitcoin purchases or sales and issuing no shares through its ATM program. The company now holds 845,050 BTC, acquired for $63.73 billion at an average price of $75,412 per coin. Strategy also increased its digital credit securities repurchase authorization from $1 billion to $2 billion, with $1.19 billion remaining available. Its USD Reserve stands at $5.10 billion, with another $1.44 billion in USD Cash. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2097307881636860169

NEW: BLOCKSTREAM SAYS LIQUID NETWORK RESTART IS BEING PREPARED. Following the recent security incident and movement of funds, Blockstream says updated software has been deployed as Liquid Federation members prepare for a coordinated network restart. The company says its teams remain focused on further hardening the network and ensuring the return of assets. Blockstream thanked the Bitcoin community for its patience, support, advice, and assistance, and said further updates will follow. Source: https://x.com/bitcoinnewscom/status/2097129152306450529

LIQUID NETWORK UPDATE ❗️ "We are aware of a security incident on Liquid . Purported white-hat hackers have withdrawn ~4,000 BTC from the Liquid Federation wallet. Blockstream is working on contacting them on-chain with a signed message. Funds were withdrawn via the SideSwap PAK (Peg-out Authorization Key), but that key was not compromised, nor were any others. Exchanges have been notified and have already paused (or will pause) LBTC deposits and withdrawals. Other Liquid assets such as USDT, DePix, and RWAs are unaffected. Bridge nodes have been temporarily disabled & no new transactions can be submitted to the network. The Liquid sidechain is paused until this issue is resolved. Liquid wallets will be impacted, and we're sorry for any inconvenience. Federation members are actively working on resolving this to restore normal network activity. Monitor the situation via mempool 's liquid .network site: https://mempool.space/address/bc1qdlld6antmv4xug242ed83q7k4rqw50cwfns38szx4qu2f4jwaxxsuhwxxr "
